Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Presence of blood and protein is noted but without casts. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
